headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic designer with commercial experience in digital and print creatives, brand guidelines, and visual identity systems.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: Photoshop, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Figma, Framer, Webflow

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Branding, visual identity, print production, typography, layout, social and marketing creative

skills.label: Process
skills.items: Design systems, wireframing, prototyping, AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly)

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives for branding, recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Collaborated with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Utilised AI-assisted workflows via ChatGPT and Adobe Firefly for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to improve user flows and interface usability.
Created wireframes and prototypes for product visuals and marketing assets.
Worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Delivered a complete logo, typography system, and colour palette adhering to brand guidelines.

projects.name: Fashion Brand Social Campaign
bullets: Designed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her commercial graphic design experience at Ascent Business Solutions, highlighting brand guidelines, print production, and collateral creation matching the TNM Furnitech requirements.
